##############################################################################
# Tarraconian Chancellery - core scripted effects
#
# The per-title lists (tarr_apply_static_titles_effect and
# tarr_apply_dynamic_titles_effect) are generated by build_mod.ps1 into
# tarr_chancellery_title_list_effects.txt.
##############################################################################

# Scope: landed title.
# NAME = loc key of the direct Tarraconian adaptation
# HIST = loc key of the 1059 historical resolution (same as NAME when the
#        title is not anachronistic)
tarr_rename_title_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = tarr_active
			has_global_variable = tarr_culture
			tarr_title_qualifies_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = tarr_direct_mode }
			set_title_name = $NAME$
		}
		else = {
			set_title_name = $HIST$
		}
		set_variable = { name = tarr_renamed value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		# Only revert titles this mod renamed itself
		limit = { has_variable = tarr_renamed }
		reset_title_name = yes
		remove_variable = tarr_renamed
	}
}

# Re-evaluate every title in the list (rename, or revert if no longer qualifying)
tarr_refresh_all_titles_effect = {
	tarr_apply_static_titles_effect = yes
	tarr_apply_dynamic_titles_effect = yes
}
